scope.note: Batch 1 promotional exaggeration and unsupported claims were not treated as acceptable standards. Cottonworld brand and authenticity rules remained authoritative.

benchmark.batch_1_faq_pattern: Nine of ten benchmark documents contain five FAQ questions; the T-shirt document is a structural outlier.
benchmark.batch_2_faq_pattern: All fourteen documents contain three FAQ questions.

checks.evidence: Every Batch 2 document is below the shortest Batch 1 document. Batch 2 averages 570 words versus 1207 in Batch 1.
checks.fix: Expand each page with category-specific decision support and two additional useful FAQs without copying unsupported Batch 1 claims.

checks.evidence: Shop Men's Looks Online has five complete body paragraphs styled as Heading 2: Look at the role of each piece..., For a day that includes a meeting..., Compare men's shirts..., A look usually feels balanced..., and A complete look may combine different fabrics....
checks.fix: Change the five paragraphs to Normal text and retain only their preceding section labels as Heading 2.

checks.evidence: All Batch 2 pages have three FAQs; nine of ten Batch 1 benchmark pages have five.
checks.fix: Add two non-duplicative, category-specific FAQs per Batch 2 page where the answers are supported by live product or category facts.

checks.evidence: No exact sentence duplication was found across Batch 2, but the same Explore Related Collections and product-page/size-guide framework recurs across most pages; Explore Related Collections appears in thirteen documents.
checks.fix: Vary section purpose and phrasing during expansion so each page addresses its category's distinct decisions.

checks.evidence: No adjacent duplicate words, malformed encoding, placeholders, obvious garment-reference errors or broken sentence fragments were found in the fourteen current documents.
The copy stays calm and practical, directs changing product facts to live listings, and avoids unsupported performance, sustainability, health and absolute-superiority claims.
Native Docs inspection found 59 clickable link runs. Every link is blue and underlined. Seven unique Cottonworld collection targets returned HTTP 200 on 2026-09-08.

Current Google Doc text scored 6.00 to 9.07 on the Strique local AI-pattern risk gate, below the blocking threshold of 20. The highest score was Men's Shirts, T-Shirts & Jackets at 9.07 due to repeated sentence starts. All pages triggered the harness's generic-conclusion-heading signal.
checks.fix: Treat as an editorial signal only. Vary repeated openings and replace generic framework sections with category-specific information during expansion.
